summary: This directory centralizes the management and retrieval of historical approval data for users and tools within the application, ensuring a dedicated interface for accessing past approval records.
responsibilities: Managing access to user-specific approval history
Providing lookup capabilities for tool-related approval logs
relationships: The Approval History service acts as the primary access point for both user and tool approval data.
Approval records are retrieved based on the intersection of specific user identities and tool identifiers.
designDecisions: Service-oriented interface definition for data access
Separation of historical data retrieval from primary operational workflows
